abort.reset_successful: Home Assistant has forgotten the detected temperature precision and uses 1 °C controls until device support is verified again.

not_verified.description:
**Status:** Not yet verified
**Available control step:** 1 °C

The device remains fully usable. Half-degree controls become available once the device has accepted a half-degree temperature, for example one set by an automation.
not_verified.title: Temperature precision

reset.description: Home Assistant will forget the previously detected resolution and use 1 °C controls until device support is verified again. This does not change the air conditioner's current settings.
reset.title: Reset temperature precision detection?

unavailable.description:
**Status:** Automatic detection unavailable for this adapter
**Available control step:** 1 °C
unavailable.title: Temperature precision

whole_degree.description:
**Status:** 1 °C resolution detected
**Available control step:** 1 °C

The device did not accept a half-degree temperature, so Home Assistant offers whole degrees.
whole_degree.title: Temperature precision
